scenes.title: Honey Bunny's Dress-Up Day Goodnight
scenes.subtitle: A Bedtime Story  •  Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Honey Bunny Kidz presents: Honey Bunny's Dress-Up Day Goodnight!
Today was Dress-Up Day! Honey Bunny hopped into her playroom in her very own costume.
Mama, look at me! I am round, and I have little yellow seeds, and a green leafy hat!
Oh my! You are a sweet little strawberry!
What color is my strawberry costume? Can you tell me?
Red! Yes, it's red! Red like a juicy strawberry.
Your friends are coming over for a dress-up parade. I wonder what they will be?
Knock, knock!
In came Mimi Kitten, all yellow and twinkly.
Twinkle, twinkle! Hello, Honey! Can you guess what shape I am?
You are a star! A big, bright star!
My star has pointy points. Let's count them together. Ready?
One. Two. Three. Four. Five!
Five points! Mimi, you are the twinkliest star!
Then Pip Puppy marched in, in a red helmet and a yellow coat with shiny stripes.
Woof! Hello, friends! What am I dressed as? Can you guess?
I am a firefighter! A pretend one.
Firefighters are brave helpers. They help people stay safe.
And today, I will help my friends! That's my job.
Time for the dress-up parade! Everyone, round the rug we go!
March, march, round we go! Dress-up friends all in a row!
Can you march with us? Lift your knees up high. March, march!
A strawberry, a fire pup, a twinkly star. Wave hello, wherever you are!
Now twirl around, slowly, like a spinning top. Can you twirl too?
Clap! Clap!
But then, wobble, wobble! Pip's big helmet slid down over his eyes.
Oopsie! Everything is dark! I can't see my friends!
Don't worry, Pip. I can help! I'll push your helmet up, nice and gently.
Peekaboo! I can see again! Thank you, Mimi. You helped the helper!
Soon the sky turned pink. The sun was going down, and it was time to go home with their mamas.
Bye bye, Honey! That was the best parade ever!
Goodnight, little strawberry! See you tomorrow!
Bye bye, friends! Can you wave goodbye too? Wave, wave!
After bath time, it was nearly bedtime. But Honey was still holding her strawberry costume.
Mama, can I sleep in my strawberry costume? I love being a strawberry.
Costumes are for playing, my sweet. For sleeping, we wear something soft and cosy.
What do we wear to bed? Do you know?
Pajamas!
That's right! Your costume can rest on the chair, right next to you.
Look, Mama! My soft blue pajamas have little white dots, like tiny stars!
Let's do our sleepy stretch. Reach up, up, up, tall like Mimi's star. Can you reach up high?
Now curl down small, round like a little strawberry.
And now, a slow breath. Breathe in, like smelling a sweet strawberry.
And breathe out, soft and slow. Ahhh.
I feel all floppy and sleepy now.
Mama tucked Honey into her warm bed.
Goodnight, Pip the firefighter. Goodnight, Mimi the star. Goodnight, my strawberry.
If you had a dress-up day, what would you be? A star? A strawberry? Something new?
Goodnight, my little strawberry. I love you.
I love you too, Mama.
And Honey Bunny drifted off to sleep, dreaming of marching, twirling, and twinkly stars.
Now it's your turn, little one. Close your eyes, and have the sweetest dreams.

scenes.title: Sweet Dreams!
scenes.subtitle: See you next time on Honey Bunny Kidz

lines.text: Goodnight!
